III Reading Passage Comprehension

My name is Nam. I have many hobbies such as doing yoga, going swimming, and collecting coins. I enjoy doing yoga every morning because it helps me relax and stay healthy. I also like going swimming at the weekend with my friends. My sister, Lan, loves collecting dolls and making models. She uses cardboard and glue to create beautiful things. We often talk about our hobbies and share ideas. Sometimes we join a hobby club at school. I think hobbies are very important because they make life more interesting.

Quick Vocabulary & Grammar Review:

  • Gerunds: Sau các động từ chỉ sở thích/ghét như like, enjoy, hate, love, adore, detest ta sử dụng động từ thêm đuôi -ing (ví dụ: going swimming, collecting coins).
  • Present Simple: Đối với các chủ ngữ ngôi thứ ba số ít (She, He, It, My sister...), động từ thường phải được chia hợp lý ở thì hiện tại đơn (ví dụ: She does, He enjoys).
  • Interested in: Cấu trúc "be interested in + V-ing" đồng nghĩa với "like/enjoy + V-ing".
